entries.en: trees; grove, woodland; forest (森)

entries.zh: 秀美，秀丽（树木、树丛秀美）
entries.en: beautiful, fine (of trees and groves); elegant (秀)

entries.zh: 秀茂，繁茂开花（树木茂盛）
entries.en: flourishing, in blossom; luxuriant growth (秀茂)

entries.zh: 秀嫩，花开鲜嫩；花木盛开娇嫩
entries.en: in full flower, blossoming; tender and fresh (of foliage, 秀嫩)

entries.zh: 无顶枝、无支架之树；孤立之树
entries.en: tree without a leader or support; lone tree
entries.notes: 汉字（哑/咀）与 M、R 音栏均存疑，中文词无法确指；义仅据 L 栏 sin guia（树无顶枝/支架）推断。

entries.en: cluster, clump; numeral classifier for trees (叢)

entries.zh: 一丛花；量词「丛」的用例（一丛＝一簇/一棵）
entries.en: a cluster of flowers (一叢花); example of the classifier with numeral 'one' (L: un árbol)
tree (numeral classifier 株); stump, standing trunk

entries.zh: 郁郁（树木茂盛秀美）；繁茂
entries.en: lush, luxuriant; beautiful tree (鬱, dense foliage)
mast; mast-timber, mast-tree (桅)

entries.zh: 枯，干枯（树失汁液而枯）；枯木
entries.en: withered, dry; dry tree without sap (枯)
Chinese toon tree (椿樹, Toona sinensis); L lemma doubtful: 'árbol de la paciencia' (?)
entries.notes: 汉字椿樹与 M、R 音栏互证一致；L 栏 paciencia 读法存疑，西语义项待考。

entries.en: tree yielding paste or gum (糊); L lemma corrupt: 'árbol del apriamiento' (?)
entries.notes: L 栏 apriamiento/primiencia 两读均难通，与「糊」之义关联无法定夺。

entries.en: local tree name 'çinguaia' (chars 孤啞頭); species undetermined
entries.notes: L çinguaia/sin gaia、H 哑/咀、R tēn/kēñ 三处均存疑，树种无法确指。

entries.en: a tree resembling the 'saponia' (reading uncertain); chars 墓蔭 'grave-shade'
entries.notes: L saponia/espulma 两读难通，与「墓蔭」未获互证，语义存疑。

entries.en: old, unprofitable tree; useless old tree
entries.notes: 第二字（哑/咀）读法存疑；「老而无用」之义据 L 栏与「樹」立义。

entries.en: barren tree, without fruit (L text corrupt)
entries.notes: L 栏文句残讹（sin ga, sin fruta ymu），H 哀/衰 两读难定；义据 sin fruta 推断。

entries.en: fruit-bearing tree (L text corrupt; 'chas palo' undetermined)
entries.notes: L 两读皆残讹，H 哀/棗、M、R 各栏互歧，无法立义。

entries.en: ironwood; tree hard as iron (鐵樹)
'過脈' — vein/sap passing through; L lemma 'congia' uncertain
entries.notes: L congia/congua 存疑；「過脈」在树木语境中的义项无法定夺。

entries.en: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.notes: 四栏皆 [空]，原稿此行无词条可释。

entries.en: chest, box, coffer; ark (arca)
trunks and traveling boxes (箱籠); 'apetaco', cf. petaca
entries.notes: L apetaco 疑为 petaca（皮箱/藤箱）类词之讹或加头写法，属推断；「箱籠」义明确。

entries.en: arquebus, harquebus (銃); pike ('picca'); third term 'matafuyo' corrupt, undetermined
entries.notes: arcabuz＝铳四栏互证明确；picca/matafuyo 残讹，仅铳之义可靠。
